name: Will It Rain
description: Find out at a glance whether you need an umbrella today, with the chance of rain hour by hour and the next 7 days.
prompt: A weather app that answers one question: will it rain today and in the next hours. Use the free Open-Meteo API with no key, ask for the location or let me search a city, show a big friendly answer with an umbrella or sun, the chance of rain hour by hour as a chart for the next 24 hours, and the next 7 days. Texts in Spanish if the phone is in Spanish, otherwise in English. Save my last city.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Descubre de un vistazo si hoy necesitas paraguas, con la probabilidad de lluvia hora a hora y los próximos 7 días.
